short.en: Filterable requesters / observers / assignees in the GLPI 11 high-level API.

long.en: Adds requesters, observers, assignees (users) and requester_groups, observer_groups, assignee_groups to the Ticket, Change and Problem schemas of the high-level REST API as real SQL joins, so RSQL filters such as assignees.id==42 or requesters.username==jdoe work server-side. Works around glpi-project/glpi#20743.
